else.text: Biosecurity let you through? Then you'll be wanting a tot for the Boss. Here. It's the good stuff: a measure of whisky in a little flask. Not for you. For the grave. I will be checking.

shopkeeper.text: Welcome to the museum shop: the only shop on the island, which has done wonders for our reviews. Penguin things, ship's biscuit and a soup the whalers swore by.
Thank you. Mind the penguin on the way out. It's a toy. Probably.
